description: This source file implements a fuzzing harness for the disk cache component of Chromium, utilizing protobuf commands to simulate cache operations and testing cache backend implementations.

classes.name: DiskCacheLPMFuzzer
classes.description: A class that manages fuzzing operations on disk cache backends, including creating, opening, closing, and manipulating cache entries based on protobuf commands.

methods.name: RunCommands
methods.description: Executes a sequence of fuzzing commands on the disk cache backend, handling various cache operations asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Initializes the cache backend as in-memory, simple, or blockfile based on the specified parameters.

methods.name: HandleSetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: CloseAllRemainingEntries
methods.description: Closes all open cache entries to prevent leaks before destruction.

methods.name: RunTaskForTest
methods.description: Runs a backend task synchronously for testing purposes.

methods.name: WaitOnEntry
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous cache entry operation to complete.

methods.name: OpenCacheEntryCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a cache entry is opened, handling success or failure.

methods.name: IsValidEntry
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry is valid (not closed).
